armies.name: The Empire
armies.subtitle: Faith, steel and gunpowder
armies.description: Build an Empire army using State Troops, Knightly Orders, Wizards, War Machines and auxiliary forces.

armies.name: High Elves
armies.subtitle: The hosts of Ulthuan
armies.description: Build a High Elf army with disciplined infantry, elite warriors, swift cavalry, mages, dragons, chariots and bolt throwers.

armies.name: Orcs & Goblins
armies.subtitle: A tide of green anarchy
armies.description: Build an Orcs & Goblins army with Orcs, Goblins, cavalry, monsters, chariots, shamans and special characters.

armies.name: Dwarfs
armies.subtitle: Ancient holds and unbreakable resolve
armies.description: Build a Dwarf army with elite infantry, Slayers, Runesmiths, runic items, artillery, Gyrocopters and special characters.

armies.name: Skaven
armies.subtitle: The teeming children of the Horned Rat
armies.description: Build a Skaven army with Clanrat mainstay rules, expendable hordes, elite clans, Rat Ogres, weapon teams, warpstone engines and notorious special characters.

armies.name: Vampire Counts
armies.subtitle: Bloodlines, necromancy and the restless dead
armies.description: Build a Vampire Counts army with the five bloodlines, bloodline powers, core undead regiments, monsters and Von Carstein special characters.

armies.name: Tomb Kings
armies.subtitle: The deathless legions of Nehekhara
armies.description: Build a Tomb Kings army with Mummy royalty, Undead Priests, Tomb Guard, chariots, constructs, scorpions, catapults and the Casket of Souls.

armies.name: Classic Undead
armies.subtitle: The mixed legions of old
armies.description: Build a Classic Undead army with Liches, Necromancers, Wights, Vampires, Mummies and the mixed regiments of the old Undead list.

armies.name: Chaos Warriors
armies.subtitle: Armoured champions of the Dark Gods
armies.description: Build a pure Chaos Warriors army with Champions, Sorcerers, Marauders, Warriors, Knights, chariots, monsters and Marks of Chaos.

armies.name: Beastmen
armies.subtitle: The savage children of Chaos
armies.description: Build a pure Beastmen army with Gors, Ungors, Bestigors, Minotaurs, Dragon Ogres, Centaurs, monsters and Ambush.

armies.name: Chaos Daemons
armies.subtitle: The hosts beyond the veil
armies.description: Build a pure Daemon army using the servants of Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle, Slaanesh and Chaos Undivided.

armies.name: Chaos Warband
armies.subtitle: One Dark Power, many servants
armies.description: Build a mixed Warriors, Beastmen and Daemons force dedicated to one Chaos Power, chosen at the start of army building.

armies.name: Chaos Warhost
armies.subtitle: The united hosts of Chaos
armies.description: Build a 2,000+ point mixed Chaos force combining Warriors, Beastmen, Daemons and followers of different Chaos Powers.

armies.name: Chaos Dwarfs
armies.subtitle: Tyrants of the Dark Lands
armies.description: Build a Chaos Dwarfs army with High Hats, slave regiments, Bull Centaurs, sorcery and artillery, with selectable Classic, Old School and Modern army styles.

armies.name: Dark Elves
armies.subtitle: The cruel hosts of Naggaroth
armies.description: Build a Dark Elves army with ruthless infantry, Witch Elves, Assassins, Dark Riders, Cold Ones, monsters, chariots, sorcery and the Witch King's champions.

armies.name: Wood Elves
armies.subtitle: Guardians of the deep forest
armies.description: Build a Wood Elves army with selectable Classic and Savage army styles, forest spirits, scouts, cavalry, chariots, Treemen, Sprites and optional Zoat allies.

armies.name: The Grand Army of Bretonnia
armies.subtitle: Knights, peasants and chivalry
armies.description: Build the Grand Army of Bretonnia with peasant levies, Men-at-Arms, Chevaliers, wizards, virtues, war machines and named heroes.

armies.name: Lizardmen
armies.subtitle: Cold-blooded servants of the Old Ones
armies.description: Build a Lizardmen army with Slann Mage Priests, Saurus, Skinks, Kroxigors, Terradons, Stegadons, Salamanders and jungle monsters.

armies.name: Dogs of War
armies.subtitle: Mercenaries from across the Old World
armies.description: Build a Dogs of War army with Human mainstay troops, exotic mercenaries, Regiments of Renown, Paymasters, hireling wizards and artillery.

armies.name: Halflings of the Moot
armies.subtitle: Foresters, feasts and unlikely heroes
armies.description: Build a Halflings of the Moot army with militia, archers, riders, travelling wizards, liberated magic, Empire or Wood Elf allies, Treemen and the legendary Hot-Pot.

armies.name: Ogre Mercenaries
armies.subtitle: Hired muscle with enormous appetites
armies.description: Build an Ogre Mercenaries army with native Ogre warbands, shamans, Maneaters, Lead-belchers, monsters and one selectable allied tribe.

armies.name: Kislev
armies.subtitle: Defenders of the frozen north
armies.description: Build a Kislev army with Boyars, Ice Witches, Kossars, elite cavalry, bear riders, scouts, beasts, artillery and legendary rulers of the frozen north.

armies.name: Norse
armies.subtitle: Warriors from the far north
armies.description: Build a Norse army with Sea or Land Raider Hirds, heroic individuals, Shieldwalls, Berserkers, Dwarfs, beasts, Mammoths and ancient magic.

armies.name: The Slann Empire
armies.subtitle: The ancient empire of the Slann
armies.description: Build the restored Slann Empire with Mage Priests, decadent Slann warriors, Lizardman auxiliaries, Native Tribes, jungle monsters and ancient technological Heirlooms.
